context: Hiroshi-boss and Yuki discuss a company lawsuit.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: corporate legal; lawsuit vocabulary (訴訟/弁護士/措置/裁判) in natural home.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 取引先から、訴訟を起こされました。
lines.en: A client has filed a lawsuit against us.
lines.style: serious office woman voice, soft warm concerned clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 弁護士に、すぐ相談しよう。
lines.en: Let's consult the lawyer right away.
lines.style: decisive boss voice, soft warm composed clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 弁護士は、和解を勧めています。
lines.style: measured office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 裁判になれば、時間がかかるな。
lines.en: If it goes to trial, it'll take time.
lines.style: thoughtful boss voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 早めの措置が、必要だと思います。
lines.en: I think early measures are needed.
lines.style: earnest office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 我が社は、犯罪に関わっていない。
lines.en: Our company isn't involved in any crime.
lines.style: firm boss voice, soft warm composed clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 弁護士と、措置をまとめます。
lines.en: I'll work out the measures with the lawyer.
lines.style: reliable office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 裁判は、できれば避けたいな。
lines.en: I'd like to avoid a trial if possible.
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm composed closing clarity throughout
